notes.title: Better Borrow & Lend
notes.detail: Keeping track of money you've lent to friends and paid back is now smoother and clearer.

notes.title: Suggestions and bug reports
notes.detail: Improved screens for suggesting a feature or reporting a problem, so it's quicker to tell us what you need.

notes.title: Notifications open the right screen
notes.detail: Tapping a notification now takes you straight to the screen it's about, or to Google Play when an update is ready.

notes.title: Cleaner emails
notes.detail: Sign-up and password reset emails have a fresh, simpler design that's easier to read.

notes.title: More reliable sign-in emails
notes.detail: Verification and password reset emails keep arriving even on busy days, with a clear timer before you can ask for a new link.
